title: Asian-style Fish & Chips
subtitle: with roasted sweet potato wedges & green beans
description: Take a flavour trip to Asia with this twist on classic fish & chips. This soy and rice wine-marinated basa is fried to flaky perfection and sided with crispy sweet potato wedges and a crunchy green bean salad. Squeeze over fresh lemon and dig in!

ingredients.name: Asian Marinade
ingredients.prep: (40ml Rice Wine Vinegar & 40ml Low Sodium Soy Sauce)

instructions.title: ROASTED GOODNESS
instructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread out the sweet potato wedges on a roasting tray, coat in oil, and season. Roast in the hot oven for 30-35 minutes until cooked through and crisping up. At the halfway mark, sprinkle over 1/2 the oriental rub. Toss to coat and leave to roast for the remaining time.

instructions.title: MARINATE
instructions.text: Pat dry the basa with some paper towel. Place the Asian marinade, grated ginger, the remaining oriental rub, 20ml of oil, and a sweetener of choice in a bowl. Whisk to combine and add the basa. Toss to coat and set aside to marinate.

instructions.title: GREEN BEANS
instructions.text: Place a nonstick pan on a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, fry the sliced green beans for 3-4 minutes until charred but still crunchy. Remove from the pan and place in a salad bowl.

instructions.title: BASA
instructions.text: Return the pan, wiped down if necessary, to a medium heat with a drizzle of oil. When hot, remove the basa from the marinade and fry for 2-3 minutes per side. In the final minute, add the marinade and baste the fish.

instructions.title: SALAD
instructions.text: Combine the rinsed green leaves with the fried green beans, a pinch of zest, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Toss to combine.

instructions.title: DINNER IS SERVED
instructions.text: Plate up the charred basa and serve with the roasted goodness and salad on the side. Garnish with a lemon wedge. Well done Chef!
